Team & partners —

Drafting the last-mile plan for Redwood's IgniteConf booth (booth F12). Key asks below — please scan and confirm gaps by EOD today.

- Crew composition: we expect 4 ambassadors onsite. I attached the draft itinerary and the provisional badge list. Can Marissa confirm the final two names?
- Arrival windows: crew arrive between 10:45–13:20 on Tuesday (different flights). We need a single pickup at West Entrance at 13:30 for shuttle to the loading dock. Evan, can TransLines do a single consolidated shuttle from West Entrance to Venue loading?
- Badge pickup: Liam — please confirm if badges can be collected ahead of time or if our reps need to pick up onsite (and what ID you require).
- Freight / load-in: we have a 2x pallet equipment delivery via ground coordinator (Evan) arriving 14:00. Loading dock slot requested for 14:30–15:30.
- Contingency: if any crew's inbound flight delays >60m, plan a relay: current on-call is Vanessa (local) to cover first shift until replacement arrives. Vanessa — can you be onsite at 11:00 if we need to swap?

Attachments: itinerary_lastmile_v2.pdf (draft itinerary), crew_badge_list.csv (provisional names & dietary notes).

Notes:
- Two crew members have vegetarian meals; one has a nut allergy — flagged in the CSV.
- We have one international crew (visa ETA document attached in my notes folder). Any extra security screening for international IDs?

Next steps: Marissa confirm final names and flight ETA offsets; Liam confirm badge pickup and exhibitor entrance procedure; Evan confirm shuttle + loading dock slot.

Thanks,
